messages.subject: Variance estimates in CDS
parts:
Dear Distance Experts

I am a new user, currently doing an analysis to compare kestrel populations=
(from line transects surveys) in two areas. I wish to do a power analysis =
to determine what sample size I need to be able to detect a 10% difference =
between density estimates in the two areas, however to do this (as far as I=
'm aware) I need the variance of the estimates generated by Distance for my=
pilot survey. In the Analysis Inputs menu it gives different options regar=
ding how to calculate the variance, and whether or not to bootstrap, but no=
'display' options. In the output it shows SE and/or 95% CIs depending on w=
hich element of the analysis is being shown (e.g. encounter rate, density e=
tc.) but not variance.

Does anyone know whether there is a way to display variance estimates in th=
e results of the analysis? And if so what it is?!

Many many thanks

Bryony


Dr. Bryony Tolhurst
Conservation Biologist
Hawk Conservancy Trust

messages.subject: AW: [DIST-SAMP] Variance estimates in CDS
parts:
Dear Bryony,=20
there is no way to display the variance of an estimator directly in =
DISTANCE,
however the SE of that estimator is the square root of the variance (See
Buckland et al. 2001, Chapter 3.6.1), so it's really a simple task to
calculate it manually...

Tim
